title: Rav Acha of Karchina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 33a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.33a.22-23), raising a difficulty against Rabbi Elazar, and Rabbi Elazar answered him. Hyman calls the Rav Ada reading in Sanhedrin 99a an error and says that it should read Rav Acha, as he reports in Dikdukei Soferim, for Rav Acha of Karchina was Rava’s student.[^1]

notes.text: In Berakhot, Rav Acha of Karchina challenges Rabbi Elazar on the example of vengeance and Rabbi Elazar answers. Hyman reports the Sanhedrin reading from Dikdukei Soferim and argues for Rav Acha on chronological grounds.
